CC-006Warrant reviewed 2026-09-07 · expires 2027-01-05

The E2 pipeline rehearsed on synthetic mechanisms

CC-Framework's E2 measurement pipeline was rehearsed end to end on three synthetic guardrail mechanisms: 66 observation rows conform to the frozen E2 schema with zero validator violations, the pre-registered negative controls behave (the common-cause control attains pA(1-pA) to 1e-9), and the finding records the result as a null at n=22 with a quantified cost for real E2 (~1097 shared items for epsilon=0.05). E2 itself is not run.

01Falsifier — what changes this claim

Replaying the bound dry-run artifacts fails to reproduce the stated 66 conforming rows, zero validator violations, negative-control behavior, or the recorded n=22 null and cost calculation, or shows that a real E2 run was represented as the synthetic rehearsal.

Consequence REJECT

This is the condition and consequence recorded in the registry. The vocabulary this is published in defines what each consequence commits the author to.

02Scope

The dry-run finding document at the bound commit. Synthetic toy mechanisms only; not deployed guardrails, not a real population, not E2. Operating points were not matched. The added 2000-permutation analysis is exploratory and does not replace the frozen single-draw control.

03Forbidden rescues

Repairs declared unavailable in advance; using one after a failure would breach the recorded commitment.

  • do not substitute a repaired corpus, changed mechanism, or updated harness for the bound dry run
  • do not report a partial replay or a result under changed criteria as confirmation of the original rehearsal
04Non-claims — what this does not license
  • this is not E2 and does not move E2 off untested; the mechanisms are toy filters in the repository, not deployed guardrails
  • the observed dependence is a null at this scale, not evidence of independence or of any real-guardrail dependence
  • validating the instrument establishes nothing about the safety, representativeness, or deployment behavior of any real system
